facts.claim: Prague's local fee for a stay (poplatek z pobytu) is 50 CZK per person for every started day of a paid stay except the day of arrival (in practice per night), for stays of up to 60 consecutive days with one provider.

facts.claim: Czech law caps the local fee for a stay at 50 CZK per person per day; Prague charges the maximum.

facts.claim: Four Seasons Hotel Prague: 157 accommodations (138 rooms, 19 suites) across four buildings by the Vltava near Charles Bridge; CottoCrudo Italian restaurant; AVA Spa with vitality pool overlooking Prague Castle; Modern Room 33 m2 (smallest category); rooms face the river or the streets.
